metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace exposing the CodeEraser passive guard.

plugins.name: codeeraser
plugins.description: CodeEraser passive guard: PreToolUse duplicate-write interception, Stop audit, SessionStart health — backed by a per-project winnowing clone index daemon. The starter downloads the SHA256-pinned ce binary from GitHub Releases on first run (manifest.env pins); a locally installed `ce` on PATH also works.
